package sample

import (
	"time"

	cachealias "github.com/frostgrove/vv/cache"
)

type ProjectionKey struct {
	TenantID string
	Revision uint64
}

type GlobalKey struct {
	Fingerprint string
}

type Payload struct {
	Name string
}

var Projections = cachealias.Auto[ProjectionKey, string](
	cachealias.Hot.With(
		cachealias.MaxValueBytes(2<<20),
		cachealias.NegativeFor(time.Minute),
	),
)

var Globals = cachealias.Auto[GlobalKey, Payload]()

var ExplicitFactory = cachealias.New[string, string]
